decisions.choice: the man of God: a title for a prophet, one who speaks God's word
decisions.reason: The title is given to prophets and to those God sends with his message (Joshua 14:6; 1 Samuel 9:6-10; 1 Kings 17:24). Here it is used of Moses for the first time; Psalm 90 is headed with the same words. It names his office, not only his character.

decisions.choice: the blessing before his death: a father's last words over his family
decisions.reason: As Jacob blessed his sons before he died (Genesis 49:1-28; compare 27:1-4), Moses blesses the tribes. Such last words were more than a wish: they were spoken in God's name and looked ahead to each tribe's future. The poem itself runs from verse 2 to verse 29; this verse is its heading, in prose.

decisions.choice: pronounced over
decisions.reason: Balanced says the blessing was "pronounced over" the people, so that "blessing ... blessed" does not stand side by side. Literal keeps the repeated root.

decisions.choice: no line breaks in this verse
decisions.reason: This verse is the narrator's prose heading, so it is not set in lines. The poem that follows is.

decisions.choice: the narrator's frame (this verse and the introductions "De Lévi il dit") in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("bénit", "prononça", "il dit") and the passé composé at Readable ("a donné", "Voici ce qu'il a dit"); the poem itself is Moses speaking, so what God has done is in the passé composé at every level ("est venu", "est devenu roi")
alternatives: passé simple in the poem too
decisions.reason: French narrative tense follows the style guide by level; a speech keeps the tenses of speech, and the Blessing is Moses' own words from verse 2 to verse 29.

decisions.choice: "chúc phước" for Moses pronouncing the blessing
decisions.reason: Vietnamese keeps "ban phước" for God, who gives the blessing, and uses "chúc phước" for a person who speaks it over others, as a father does over his sons.

decisions.choice: "복을 빌어 주다" for Moses blessing the people
decisions.reason: A person blessing others asks God's good for them, as Jacob does in the Korean Genesis 49:28 ("복을 빌어 주다"); "복을 주다" is kept for God, who gives the blessing.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic in this chapter; "የእስራኤል ልጆች" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English marks pronouns for God with the deity_pronoun setting so that a reader can capitalise them; the Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the Amharic has no such spans. Amharic "ልጆች" already includes daughters, so "the sons of Israel" needs no gender span either.

decisions.choice: "የእግዚአብሔር ሰው" ("the man of God")
decisions.reason: Here Elohim, with the article, is the one God and YHWH does not stand beside it, so it is "እግዚአብሔር", as in the style guide; the title is the familiar one for a prophet.

source.text: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה מִסִּינַ֥י בָּא֙ וְזָרַ֤ח מִשֵּׂעִיר֙ לָ֔מוֹ הוֹפִ֨יעַ֙ מֵהַ֣ר פָּארָ֔ן וְאָתָ֖ה מֵרִבְבֹ֣ת קֹ֑דֶשׁ מִֽימִינ֕וֹ אֵ֥שׁ דָּ֖ת לָֽמוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Yahweh from Sinai came, and dawned from Seir upon them; he shone forth from [the] mountain of Paran, and he came from myriads of holiness; from his right hand fire of law for them.

en.L: And he said, \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} came from Sinai and dawned on them from Seir; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shone forth from Mount Paran \q and came from [the] myriads of holiness; \q from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand [came] a fiery law for them.
en.B: He said: \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} came from Sinai and rose like the dawn on them from Seir; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shone out from Mount Paran \q and came from among myriads of holy ones; \q from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand came a law of fire for them.
en.R: Moses said: \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} came from Mount Sinai. \q Like the sunrise {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came from Seir and shone from Mount Paran. \q He came from among many thousands of holy ones. \q From {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand came a fiery law for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.

es.L: Y dijo: \q «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vino del Sinaí y desde Seír amaneció sobre ellos; \q resplandeció desde el monte Parán \q y vino de las miríadas de santidad; \q de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} diestra [salió] para ellos una ley de fuego.
es.B: Dijo: \q «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vino del Sinaí y desde Seír se levantó sobre ellos como la aurora; \q resplandeció desde el monte Parán \q y vino de entre miríadas de santos; \q de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} diestra salió para ellos una ley de fuego.
es.R: Moisés dijo: \q «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vino del monte Sinaí. \q Como el sol cuando sale, vino desde Seír y brilló desde el monte Parán. \q Vino de entre muchos miles de santos. \q De {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano derecha salió una ley de fuego para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.

fr.L: Et il dit : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est venu du Sinaï, et de Séir il s’est levé sur eux ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a resplendi depuis la montagne de Parân \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est venu des myriades de sainteté ; \q de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite [est sortie] pour eux une loi de feu.
fr.B: Il dit : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est venu du Sinaï, de Séir il s’est levé sur eux comme l’aurore ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a brillé depuis le mont Parân \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est venu du milieu de saints par myriades ; \q de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite a jailli pour eux une loi de feu.
fr.R: Moïse a dit : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est venu du mont Sinaï. \q Comme le soleil qui se lève, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est venu de Séir et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a brillé depuis le mont Parân. \q Il est venu du milieu de milliers et de milliers de saints. \q De {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main droite est venue une loi de feu pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.

sw.L: Akasema, \q "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuja kutoka Sinai, akawachomozea kutoka Seiri; \q aliangaza kutoka mlima Parani, \q akaja kutoka makumi elfu ya utakatifu; \q kutoka mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume [ilitoka] sheria ya moto kwa ajili yao.

sw.R: Musa alisema: \q "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuja kutoka Mlima Sinai. \q Kama jua linapochomoza, alikuja kutoka Seiri, akang'aa kutoka Mlima Parani. \q Alikuja kutoka katikati ya maelfu mengi ya watakatifu. \q Kutoka mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume ilikuja sheria ya moto kwa ajili ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: Và ông nói: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đến từ Si-na-i, và từ Sê-i-rơ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã rạng lên trên họ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chiếu sáng từ núi Pha-ran \q và đến từ muôn vạn [đấng] thánh; \q từ tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [có] luật pháp rực lửa cho họ.
vi.B: Ông nói: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến từ Si-na-i, và từ Sê-i-rơ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rạng lên như bình minh chiếu trên họ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tỏa sáng từ núi Pha-ran \q và đến từ giữa muôn vạn đấng thánh; \q từ tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có luật pháp rực lửa ban cho họ.
vi.R: Môi-se nói: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đến từ núi Si-na-i. \q Như mặt trời mọc, Ngài đến từ Sê-i-rơ và chiếu sáng từ núi Pha-ran. \q Ngài đến từ giữa muôn ngàn đấng thánh. \q Từ tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, luật pháp rực lửa được ban cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그가 말하였다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시내에서 오시고, 세일에서 그들 위에 떠오르셨다. \q 그분께서 바란 산에서 빛을 비추시고, \q 거룩함의 수만 [무리] 가운데서 오셨다. \q 그분의 오른손에서 그들을 위한 불타는 율법이 [나왔다].
ko.B: 그가 말하였다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시내 산에서 오시고, 세일에서 새벽빛처럼 그들 위에 떠오르셨다. \q 그분께서 바란 산에서 빛을 비추시고, \q 수만의 거룩한 이들 가운데서 오셨다. \q 그분의 오른손에서 그들을 위한 불의 율법이 나왔다.
ko.R: 모세가 말했다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시내 산에서 오셨다. \q 그분께서 해가 떠오르듯 세일에서 오시고 바란 산에서 빛나셨다. \q 수많은 거룩한 이들 가운데서 오셨다. \q 그분의 오른손에서 그분의 백성을 위한 불 같은 율법이 나왔다.

pt.L: E ele disse: \q "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} veio do Sinai e de Seir raiou sobre eles; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} resplandeceu desde o monte Parã \q e veio das miríades de santidade; \q da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão direita [saiu] uma lei de fogo para eles.
pt.B: Ele disse: \q "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} veio do Sinai e, de Seir, despontou sobre eles como a aurora; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} brilhou desde o monte Parã \q e veio do meio de miríades de seres santos; \q da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão direita saiu para eles uma lei de fogo.
pt.R: Moisés disse: \q "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} veio do monte Sinai. \q Como o nascer do sol, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} veio de Seir e brilhou desde o monte Parã. \q Ele veio do meio de muitos milhares de seres santos. \q Da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão direita saiu uma lei de fogo para o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo.

am.L: እንዲህም አለ፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሲና መጣ፤ ከሴይርም ወጣላቸው፤ \q ከፋራን ተራራ አበራ፤ \q ከቅዱሳን አእላፋትም መጣ፤ \q ከቀኙም የእሳት ሕግ ለእነርሱ [ወጣ]።
am.B: እንዲህ አለ፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሲና መጣ፤ ከሴይርም እንደ ንጋት ወጣላቸው፤ \q ከፋራን ተራራ አበራ፤ \q ከአእላፋት ቅዱሳን መካከል መጣ፤ \q ከቀኙም የእሳት ሕግ ለእነርሱ ወጣ።

decisions.choice: Sinai, Seir, Paran: the LORD's coming pictured as sunrise over the mountains of the south
decisions.reason: God's coming to his people is described like the sun rising and spreading its light from one range of hills to the next. Seir is the hill country of Edom (2:1-8), and Paran the wilderness south of Canaan (1:1; Numbers 10:12). Other old poems of God marching from the south use the same places (Judges 5:4-5; Psalm 68:8-9; Habakkuk 3:3). "Them" and "for them" are Israel, named in verses 4-5.

decisions.choice: came from the myriads of holiness: came out from among countless holy ones, the heavenly host around God
alternatives: came with myriads of holy ones
decisions.reason: The holy ones are most likely the heavenly beings who surround God (Psalm 68:18; Zechariah 14:5; Daniel 7:10). The Greek translation reads the same letters as a place, "with the myriads of Kadesh"; with one letter fewer, the Hebrew would be "Meribath-kadesh" (32:51), which would carry on the list of places in the first lines. Reviewers should check the evidence.

decisions.choice: a fiery law: the two words the scribes' margin note marks to be read, "fire" and "law"
alternatives: with him, angels at his right hand
decisions.reason: The consonants are written as one word in the Hebrew text, which no one knows the meaning of. The scribes' note says to read two words, "fire of law", and the source data follows that reading. The word for law, dat, is otherwise found only in books written much later (Ezra, Esther), so many find the reading doubtful. Proposals include "fire flashing" (lightning, as at Sinai, Exodus 19:16-18) and a word for mountain slopes (3:17; 4:49). The Greek translation has "angels with him at his right hand". The meaning is not certain.

decisions.choice: from his right hand: from his own power and authority
decisions.reason: The right hand is the hand of power (Exodus 15:6, 12). The law came to Israel from God himself (5:22). The same word can also mean the south, but here it is most naturally his hand.

decisions.choice: a double quotation mark opens here and closes at the end of verse 29; no inner quotation marks for each tribe
alternatives: single quotation marks around each tribe's saying
decisions.reason: The whole Blessing, verses 2-29, is one poem spoken by Moses. The short introductions ("Of Levi he said:") are part of the poem and its shape, not a change of speaker, so each tribe's saying is not set in quotation marks of its own; a colon follows the introduction. Words quoted inside the poem (verses 9 and 27) take single quotation marks.

decisions.choice: Moses said; for his people
decisions.reason: Readable names Moses as the speaker and says that "them" is God's people, as verses 3-5 show.

decisions.choice: "akawachomozea" (rose on them, as the sun rises)
decisions.reason: "Kuchomoza" is the word for the sun coming up, which keeps the Hebrew picture of dawn; Balanced adds "kama mapambazuko" to make it plain.

decisions.choice: "luật pháp rực lửa" (a blazing law)
decisions.reason: Follows the reading the scribes' margin note gives, "fire" and "law" as two words; Vietnamese puts "rực lửa" after the noun as a description, so the two words stay together as one picture.

decisions.choice: Moses speaks about God in the plain written style with the honorific, to God in 합쇼체 with "주님" (verses 3, 7-11), and to the tribes and to Israel in 해라체 with "너" at every level, Readable included
alternatives: 합쇼체 with "여러분" at Readable, as in Moses' speeches
decisions.reason: The blessing is a dying father's last words over his family (meaning decision on verse 1), so it takes the plain style Jacob uses for his sons in the Korean Genesis 49, at every level; the 합쇼체 of Moses' speeches at Readable is a public address and would not fit a blessing spoken over each tribe by name. Speech to God follows the Psalms (docs/korean-style.md 7a). The archaic endings of older Bibles are not used.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Korean of this chapter
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters; respect for God is carried at every level by the honorific -시-, 께서 and 그분, as docs/korean-style.md section 7 sets.

decisions.choice: the Blessing of Moses set in lines with the breaks where each English level has them; the blessings of the tribes are introduced with "ስለ … እንዲህ አለ፦" and take no inner quotation marks
decisions.reason: As in the English, one quotation opens here and closes at the end of verse 29. Each tribe's blessing is introduced by the narrator's "of X he said", for which Amharic uses the colon-like ፦ without opening another quotation.

source.text: אַ֚ף חֹבֵ֣ב עַמִּ֔ים כָּל־קְדֹשָׁ֖יו בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וְהֵם֙ תֻּכּ֣וּ לְרַגְלֶ֔ךָ יִשָּׂ֖א מִדַּבְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Also loving peoples; all his holy ones [are] in your hand; and they were led to your foot; he will take up from your words.

en.L: Indeed, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loves [the] peoples; \q all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy ones [are] in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand; \q and they sit down at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} feet; \q [each] receives from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} words.
en.B: Truly {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loves the peoples; \q all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy ones are in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand. \q They sit down at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} feet, \q and each receives {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} words.
en.R: He truly loves the tribes of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. \q All who are holy to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} are in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} care. \q They sit at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} feet \q and each one takes in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} words.

es.L: Ciertamente, ama a los pueblos; \q todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santos [están] en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano; \q y ellos se sientan a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} pies; \q [cada uno] recibe de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} palabras.
es.B: De veras ama a los pueblos; \q todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santos están en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano. \q Se sientan a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} pies, \q y cada uno recibe {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} palabras.
es.R: Él ama de verdad a las tribus de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. \q Todos los que son santos para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} están bajo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cuidado. \q Se sientan a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} pies \q y cada uno recibe {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} palabras.

fr.L: Oui, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aime les peuples ; \q tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} saints [sont] dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main ; \q et ils s’assoient à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} pieds ; \q [chacun] reçoit de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} paroles.
fr.B: Vraiment, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aime les peuples ; \q tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} saints sont dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main. \q Ils s’assoient à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} pieds, \q et chacun reçoit {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} paroles.
fr.R: Oui, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aime vraiment les tribus de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. \q Tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sont consacrés sont sous {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} garde. \q Ils s’assoient à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} pieds \q et chacun reçoit {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} paroles.

sw.L: Naam, anayapenda mataifa; \q watakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote [wamo] mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}}; \q nao huketi miguuni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}; \q [kila mmoja] hupokea maneno {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Hakika anayapenda mataifa; \q watakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote wamo mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}}. \q Wanaketi miguuni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}, \q na kila mmoja hupokea maneno {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Kweli anayapenda makabila ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Wote walio watakatifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} wako chini ya ulinzi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. \q Wanaketi miguuni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}} \q na kila mmoja anayapokea maneno {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

vi.L: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} yêu thương các dân; \q mọi [người] thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q và họ ngồi xuống dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q [mỗi người] nhận lấy từ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Thật, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} yêu thương các dân; \q mọi người thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều ở trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Họ ngồi xuống dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và mỗi người đón nhận lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài thật yêu thương các chi tộc của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Mọi người thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăm sóc. \q Họ ngồi dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và mỗi người tiếp nhận lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 참으로 그분께서 백성들을 사랑하신다. \q 그분의 거룩한 이들이 모두 주님의 손안에 있습니다. \q 그리고 그들이 주님의 발아래 앉아 \q [저마다] 주님의 말씀을 받습니다.
ko.B: 참으로 그분께서는 백성들을 사랑하신다. \q 그분의 거룩한 이들은 모두 주님의 손안에 있습니다. \q 그들이 주님의 발아래 앉아 \q 저마다 주님의 말씀을 받습니다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 정말로 그분의 백성의 지파들을 사랑하신다. \q 그분께 속한 거룩한 사람들은 모두 주님의 보살핌 안에 있습니다. \q 그들은 주님의 발아래 앉아 \q 저마다 주님의 말씀을 마음에 받아들입니다.

pt.L: Sim, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ama os povos; \q todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} santos [estão] na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão; \q e eles se sentam aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} pés; \q [cada um] recebe das {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} palavras.
pt.B: De fato, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ama os povos; \q todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} santos estão na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão. \q Eles se sentam aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} pés, \q e cada um recebe as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} palavras.
pt.R: Ele de fato ama as tribos do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo. \q Todos os que são santos para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estão sob o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} cuidado. \q Eles se sentam aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} pés \q e cada um aprende as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} palavras.

am.L: በእርግጥ ሕዝቦችን ይወዳል፤ \q ቅዱሳኑ ሁሉ በእጅህ [ናቸው]፤ \q በእግርህም አጠገብ ይቀመጣሉ፤ \q [እያንዳንዱ] ከቃልህ ይቀበላል።
am.B: በእውነት ሕዝቦችን ይወዳል፤ \q ቅዱሳኑ ሁሉ በእጅህ ናቸው። \q በእግርህ ሥር ይቀመጣሉ፤ \q እያንዳንዱም ቃልህን ይቀበላል።
am.R: የሕዝቡን ነገዶች በእውነት ይወዳል። \q ለእርሱ የተቀደሱት ሁሉ በአንተ ጥበቃ ሥር ናቸው። \q በእግርህ ሥር ይቀመጣሉ፤ \q እያንዳንዱም ቃልህን ይቀበላል።

decisions.choice: the peoples: the tribes of Israel, gathered as one people
decisions.reason: The plural can mean the nations, and some read the line as God's love for all peoples. But the verses around it speak of Israel, its holy ones and its tribes (verse 5), and Jacob was promised he would become "an assembly of peoples" (Genesis 28:3; 48:4). The line most likely speaks of the tribes.

decisions.choice: his holy ones ... your hand: both pronouns refer to God
decisions.reason: Hebrew poetry often moves from speaking about God ("his") to speaking to him ("your") in one line (32:15-18). The holy ones are his people, set apart for him (7:6; 14:2), held safe in his hand.

decisions.choice: they sit down at your feet; each receives your words: the people gathered at Sinai to hear God's teaching
alternatives: they were led at your feet
decisions.reason: The verb is found only here. It probably means to sit or lie down, as learners sit at the feet of a teacher, or to follow close behind. The next words picture each one receiving God's words, as Israel did at Sinai (5:22-27). The exact sense is not certain.

decisions.choice: the tribes of his people; in your care
decisions.reason: Readable says which peoples are meant (see m1) and gives the sense of "in your hand".

decisions.choice: "mataifa" (peoples)
decisions.reason: "Watu" would be people as persons; "mataifa" keeps the plural of peoples, which here most likely means the tribes of Israel (see the meaning decision), as Readable says. A reviewer may judge that "mataifa" pulls too strongly towards "nations".

decisions.choice: "Ngài" for God both spoken of and spoken to
alternatives: "Chúa" for the second person ("trong tay Chúa")
decisions.reason: In the poem Moses speaks of God and to God in turn; "Ngài" serves for both in Vietnamese prayer, so the switch between "his" and "your" is not visible. Keeping one word avoids a reader taking "Chúa" for a second person.

decisions.choice: The verse turns from the plain style about God ("사랑하신다") to 합쇼체 to God ("주님의 손안에 있습니다")
alternatives: one style for the whole verse
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves from "he" to "your" within the verse, both meaning God (meaning decision). Korean marks the turn to address by the change of speech level and by "주님", so the reader still sees who is spoken to.

decisions.choice: tu to God (tua mão, teus pés, tuas palavras), beside ele
decisions.reason: For the Blessing (verses 2-29). Where Moses speaks to God, Portuguese says "tu", with the capitalisation setting, as people speak to God throughout; where he speaks about him, "ele". The poem moves between the two within a line (m2), and Portuguese moves with it. "Seus" and "tua" cannot be confused, since "tu" has its own possessive.

source.text: תּוֹרָ֥ה צִוָּה־לָ֖נוּ מֹשֶׁ֑ה מוֹרָשָׁ֖ה קְהִלַּ֥ת יַעֲקֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: A law commanded to us Moses, a possession [of the] assembly of Jacob.

en.L: Moses commanded us a law, \q a possession for [the] assembly of Jacob.
en.B: Moses gave us a law to keep, \q the inheritance of the assembly of Jacob.
en.R: Moses gave us the teaching we must follow. \q It belongs to the assembly of Jacob's people as their own.

es.L: Moisés nos ordenó una ley, \q posesión de la asamblea de Jacob.
es.B: Moisés nos dio una ley para guardarla, \q la herencia de la asamblea de Jacob.
es.R: Moisés nos dio la enseñanza que debemos seguir. \q Es propiedad de la asamblea del pueblo de Jacob.

fr.L: Moïse nous a prescrit une loi, \q une possession pour l’assemblée de Jacob.
fr.B: Moïse nous a donné une loi à observer, \q l’héritage de l’assemblée de Jacob.
fr.R: Moïse nous a donné l’enseignement que nous devons suivre. \q Il appartient en propre à l’assemblée du peuple de Jacob.

sw.L: Musa alituamuru sheria, \q milki ya kusanyiko la Yakobo.
sw.B: Musa alitupa sheria tuishike, \q urithi wa kusanyiko la Yakobo.
sw.R: Musa alitupa mafundisho tunayopaswa kuyafuata. \q Ni mali ya kusanyiko la watu wa Yakobo.

vi.L: Môi-se đã truyền cho chúng ta một luật pháp, \q [làm] sản nghiệp cho hội của Gia-cốp.
vi.B: Môi-se đã ban cho chúng ta luật pháp để vâng giữ, \q là cơ nghiệp của hội Gia-cốp.
vi.R: Môi-se đã ban cho chúng ta lời dạy dỗ mà chúng ta phải làm theo. \q Lời ấy thuộc về hội dân Gia-cốp, là của riêng họ.

ko.L: 모세가 우리에게 율법을 명령하였으니, \q 야곱의 총회를 위한 소유이다.
ko.B: 모세가 우리에게 지킬 율법을 주었으니, \q 야곱의 총회가 물려받은 유산이다.
ko.R: 모세는 우리가 따라야 할 가르침을 주었다. \q 그 가르침은 야곱 자손의 총회가 길이 간직할 그들의 것이다.

pt.L: Moisés nos ordenou uma lei, \q propriedade da assembleia de Jacó.
pt.B: Moisés nos deu uma lei para guardarmos, \q a herança da assembleia de Jacó.
pt.R: Moisés nos deu o ensino que devemos seguir. \q Ele é a herança do povo de Jacó reunido em assembleia.

am.L: ሙሴ ሕግን አዘዘልን፤ \q ለያዕቆብ ጉባኤ ይዞታ [የሆነውን]።
am.B: ሙሴ የምንጠብቀውን ሕግ ሰጠን፤ \q ይህም የያዕቆብ ጉባኤ ይዞታ ነው።
am.R: ሙሴ የምንከተለውን ሕግ ሰጠን። \q ሕጉ የያዕቆብ ዘሮች ጉባኤ የራሳቸው ሀብት ነው።

decisions.choice: us: the people speak in this line
decisions.reason: In the middle of Moses' blessing the people speak of "us" and of Moses by name. The line is a confession of the whole people, gathered as in verse 5. Some take it as a later voice; either way it is part of the poem.

decisions.choice: law: God's teaching as a whole, given through Moses
decisions.reason: As at 1:5, torah is more than a list of rules: it is everything God taught Israel through Moses.

decisions.choice: a possession: something handed down and kept as the people's own
decisions.reason: The word is used of the land given to Israel to own (Exodus 6:8). Here the law is the people's treasured inheritance.

decisions.choice: teaching
decisions.reason: Readable says "teaching" for torah, as the terms for Deuteronomy set out.

decisions.choice: "chúng ta" (inclusive we)
decisions.reason: The whole people speaks this line about a law that belongs to all of them, so the inclusive "chúng ta" fits better than the exclusive "chúng tôi".

source.text: וַיְהִ֥י בִישֻׁר֖וּן מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף֙ רָ֣אשֵׁי עָ֔ם יַ֖חַד שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he was in Jeshurun king, when gathered themselves [the] heads of [the] people, together [the] tribes of Israel.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} became king in Jeshurun \q when [the] heads of [the] people gathered, \q the tribes of Israel together.
en.B: So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} became king in Jeshurun \q when the leaders of the people assembled, \q all the tribes of Israel together.
en.R: God became king over {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people Israel \q when their leaders came together \q with all the tribes of Israel.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} fue rey en Jesurún \q cuando se reunieron [los] jefes del pueblo, \q juntas las tribus de Israel.
es.B: Así llegó a ser rey en Jesurún \q cuando se congregaron los jefes del pueblo, \q todas las tribus de Israel juntas.
es.R: Dios llegó a ser rey de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo Israel \q cuando sus líderes se reunieron \q con todas las tribus de Israel.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est devenu roi en Yeshouroun \q quand se sont rassemblés [les] chefs du peuple, \q les tribus d’Israël ensemble.
fr.B: Ainsi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est devenu roi en Yeshouroun \q quand les chefs du peuple se sont réunis, \q toutes les tribus d’Israël ensemble.
fr.R: Dieu est devenu le roi de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, Israël, \q quand ses chefs se sont réunis \q avec toutes les tribus d’Israël.

sw.L: Naye akawa mfalme katika Yeshuruni, \q walipokusanyika wakuu wa watu, \q makabila ya Israeli pamoja.
sw.B: Hivyo akawa mfalme katika Yeshuruni \q viongozi wa watu walipokusanyika, \q makabila yote ya Israeli pamoja.
sw.R: Mungu akawa mfalme wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Israeli \q viongozi wao walipokutana \q pamoja na makabila yote ya Israeli.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở thành vua trong Giê-su-run \q khi các đầu [của] dân nhóm lại, \q các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên cùng nhau.
vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm vua trên Giê-su-run \q khi các thủ lĩnh của dân chúng hội họp, \q cùng với tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã trở thành vua của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên \q khi các nhà lãnh đạo của họ nhóm lại \q cùng với tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 여수룬에서 왕이 되셨다. \q 백성의 우두머리들이 모였을 때, \q 이스라엘 지파들이 함께 [모였을 때였다].
ko.B: 그리하여 그분께서 여수룬의 왕이 되셨다. \q 백성의 지도자들이 모이고 \q 이스라엘의 모든 지파가 함께 모였을 때였다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 그분의 백성 이스라엘의 왕이 되셨다. \q 그들의 지도자들이 \q 이스라엘의 모든 지파와 함께 모였을 때였다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se tornou rei em Jesurum \q quando se reuniram os chefes do povo, \q as tribos de Israel juntas.
pt.B: Assim {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se tornou rei em Jesurum, \q quando os líderes do povo se reuniram, \q todas as tribos de Israel juntas.
pt.R: Deus se tornou rei do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo Israel \q quando os líderes se reuniram \q com todas as tribos de Israel.

am.L: በይሽሩንም ንጉሥ ሆነ፣ \q የሕዝቡ አለቆች በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ፣ \q የእስራኤል ነገዶች በአንድነት።
am.B: እርሱም በይሽሩን ንጉሥ ሆነ፣ \q የሕዝቡ መሪዎች፣ \q የእስራኤል ነገዶች ሁሉ በአንድነት በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር በሕዝቡ በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ሆነ፣ \q መሪዎቻቸው \q ከእስራኤል ነገዶች ሁሉ ጋር በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ።

decisions.choice: he became king: the LORD became Israel's king
decisions.reason: The subject is not named. In the poem the LORD is the one who comes and gives the law (verses 2-4), and the Song at the Sea ends with him reigning (Exodus 15:18). Some take the king to be Moses, the leader of the gathering, or read "there was a king" as a look ahead to Israel's kings. The kingship of the LORD fits the poem best, but the line does not say.

decisions.choice: Jeshurun: a name of honor for Israel
decisions.reason: The name probably comes from the word for "upright": Israel as the upright one God made it to be (32:15; 33:26; Isaiah 44:2).

decisions.choice: when the heads of the people gathered: the assembly at Sinai
decisions.reason: The leaders and tribes gathered before God at the mountain (4:10; 5:23), where the covenant made the LORD Israel's king.

decisions.choice: God became king over his people Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says "Israel" for Jeshurun, as the terms for Deuteronomy set out, and names God as the king (see m1).

decisions.choice: "Jesurún"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish form of the name; Readable says "Israel", as the English Readable does. Used again in verse 26.

decisions.choice: "Yeshouroun"
decisions.reason: The name is transcribed from the Hebrew in French spelling, as other names without an established French form are; Readable says "Israël", as the English Readable does. Used again in verse 26.

decisions.choice: "Yeshuruni"
decisions.reason: The name is transcribed from the Hebrew with the final vowel Swahili writes; Readable says "Israeli", as the English Readable does. Used again in verse 26.

decisions.choice: "Giê-su-run" for Jeshurun
decisions.reason: The usual Protestant transliteration of this honorary name; no earlier Vietnamese text in the project has it. 33:26 uses the same form, and Deuteronomy 32:15 should match it.

decisions.choice: "여수룬" for Jeshurun
decisions.reason: The usual Protestant spelling of this name of honour for Israel (meaning decision); Readable says "이스라엘", as the English Readable does.

source.text: יְחִ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן וְאַל־יָמֹ֑ת וִיהִ֥י מְתָ֖יו מִסְפָּֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Let live Reuben and not let him die, and let be his men number.

en.L: Let Reuben live and not die, \q and let his men be [few in] number.
en.B: May Reuben live and not die out, \q even though his men are few.
en.R: May the tribe of Reuben live on and not die out, \q even though its people are few.

es.L: Viva Rubén y no muera, \q y sean sus hombres [pocos en] número.
es.B: Que Rubén viva y no se extinga, \q aunque sus hombres sean pocos.
es.R: Que la tribu de Rubén siga viviendo y no desaparezca, \q aunque tenga poca gente.

fr.L: Que Ruben vive et ne meure pas, \q et que ses hommes soient [en petit] nombre.
fr.B: Que Ruben vive et ne disparaisse pas, \q même si ses hommes sont peu nombreux.
fr.R: Que la tribu de Ruben continue à vivre et ne disparaisse pas, \q même si elle compte peu de gens.

sw.L: Reubeni na aishi wala asife, \q na watu wake wawe [wachache kwa] hesabu.
sw.B: Reubeni na aishi wala asitoweke, \q ingawa watu wake ni wachache.
sw.R: Kabila la Reubeni na liendelee kuishi lisitoweke, \q ingawa watu wake ni wachache.

vi.L: Nguyện Ru-bên sống và không chết, \q và nguyện người của nó [chỉ có] số ít.
vi.B: Nguyện Ru-bên được sống và không bị diệt vong, \q dù số người của nó ít ỏi.
vi.R: Nguyện chi tộc Ru-bên tiếp tục sống và không bị mất đi, \q dù dân số của họ ít ỏi.

ko.L: 르우벤이 살고 죽지 않기를, \q 그의 사람들이 [적은] 수가 되기를 바란다.
ko.B: 르우벤이 살아남고 사라지지 않기를 바란다. \q 비록 그의 사람들이 적을지라도.
ko.R: 르우벤 지파가 계속 살아남고 없어지지 않기를 바란다. \q 비록 그 사람들의 수가 적을지라도.

pt.L: Que Rúben viva e não morra, \q e que os seus homens sejam [poucos em] número.
pt.B: Que Rúben viva e não desapareça, \q ainda que os seus homens sejam poucos.
pt.R: Que a tribo de Rúben continue viva e não desapareça, \q mesmo que o seu povo seja pequeno.

am.L: ሮቤል በሕይወት ይኑር፤ አይሙትም፤ \q ሰዎቹም [ጥቂት] ቁጥር ይሁኑ።
am.B: ሮቤል በሕይወት ይኑር፤ አይጥፋም፤ \q ሰዎቹ ጥቂቶች ቢሆኑም።
am.R: የሮቤል ነገድ በሕይወት ይቀጥል፤ አይጥፋም፤ \q ሕዝቡ ጥቂቶች ቢሆኑም።

decisions.choice: and let his men be few in number: may Reuben survive, though small
alternatives: but let his men be few
and let not his men be few
decisions.reason: The words read "and let his men be a number", that is, few enough to count (Genesis 34:30). The line most likely asks that Reuben live on even though it is small. It could also be a wish that it stay small, as Reuben lost the firstborn's place (Genesis 49:3-4). Others carry the "not" of the first line into the second: "and let not his men be few". The Hebrew is short and the sense is not certain.

decisions.choice: Reuben: the firstborn's tribe, east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Reuben was Jacob's firstborn, and his tribe settled east of the Jordan (3:12-16; Numbers 32). The prayer that it not die out suggests a tribe at risk.

decisions.choice: the tribe of Reuben; its people
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the name stands for the tribe, as in all these sayings.

decisions.choice: a tribe spoken of as one man is "nó" at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "họ" or names the tribe
decisions.reason: Follows Jacob's blessing of the tribes in Genesis 49, where the Vietnamese already calls each son "nó"; Readable follows the English Readable, which speaks of the tribe's people. Used for every tribe in this chapter.

decisions.choice: Wishes in the form "-기를 바란다" (L, B, R) and "-기를 빈다" (R, verses 13-16, 24)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew jussives are wishes spoken over the tribe; Korean says them as wishes, as the Korean Genesis 49 does for Jacob's blessings. A command would make Moses order the tribe to survive.

decisions.choice: Rúben, Judá, Levi, Benjamim, José, Efraim, Manassés, Zebulom, Issacar, Gade, Dã, Naftali, Aser
decisions.reason: For the Blessing. Moses blesses the tribes as Jacob blessed his sons (m2 on verse 1), so the tribes keep the Portuguese names of Genesis 49, and where the Hebrew repeats Jacob's words Portuguese repeats that chapter's (verses 13-16, 17, 22).

source.text: וְזֹ֣את לִֽיהוּדָה֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ שְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ ק֣וֹל יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶל־עַמּ֖וֹ תְּבִיאֶ֑נּוּ יָדָיו֙ רָ֣ב ל֔וֹ וְעֵ֥זֶר מִצָּרָ֖יו תִּהְיֶֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And this for Judah, and he said: hear, Yahweh, [the] voice of Judah, and to his people you will bring him; his hands contended for him, and a help from his foes you will be.

en.L: And this [is] for Judah, and he said: \q Hear, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the voice of Judah, \q and bring him to his people; \q his hands contend for him, \q and a help against his foes may {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be.
en.B: This he said of Judah: \q Hear, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the voice of Judah, \q and bring him to his people. \q He fights for his cause with his own hands; \q be his help against his enemies.
en.R: This is what he said about Judah: \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, listen to Judah when they call to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Bring them to their own people. \q They fight for themselves with all their strength. \q Help them against their enemies.

es.L: Y esto [es] para Judá, y dijo: \q Oye, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, la voz de Judá, \q y llévalo a su pueblo; \q sus manos contienden por él, \q y sé {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} su ayuda contra sus adversarios.
es.B: Esto dijo de Judá: \q Escucha, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, la voz de Judá, \q y devuélvelo a su pueblo. \q Con sus propias manos lucha por su causa; \q sé su ayuda contra sus enemigos.
es.R: Esto es lo que dijo acerca de Judá: \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, escucha a los de Judá cuando {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} llamen. \q Llévalos de vuelta a su propio pueblo. \q Luchan por sí mismos con todas sus fuerzas. \q Ayúdalos contra sus enemigos.

fr.L: Et ceci [est] pour Juda, et il dit : \q Écoute, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, la voix de Juda, \q et amène-le vers son peuple ; \q ses mains combattent pour lui, \q et puisses-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} être une aide contre ses adversaires.
fr.B: Voici ce qu’il dit de Juda : \q Écoute, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, la voix de Juda, \q et ramène-le vers son peuple. \q De ses propres mains il combat pour sa cause ; \q sois son secours contre ses ennemis.
fr.R: Voici ce qu’il a dit au sujet de Juda : \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute les gens de Juda quand ils {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appellent. \q Ramène-les vers leur propre peuple. \q Ils se battent pour eux-mêmes de toutes leurs forces. \q Aide-les contre leurs ennemis.

sw.L: Na hii [ni] kwa ajili ya Yuda, akasema: \q Sikia, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sauti ya Yuda, \q umlete kwa watu wake; \q mikono yake inampigania, \q {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} uwe msaada dhidi ya adui zake.
sw.B: Kuhusu Yuda alisema hivi: \q Sikia, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sauti ya Yuda, \q umrudishe kwa watu wake. \q Anajipigania kwa mikono yake mwenyewe; \q uwe msaada wake dhidi ya adui zake.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo alivyosema kuhusu Yuda: \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wasikilize watu wa Yuda wanapokuita. \q Warudishe kwa watu wao. \q Wanajipigania kwa nguvu zao zote. \q Wasaidie dhidi ya adui zao.

vi.L: Và đây [là] cho Giu-đa, và ông nói: \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin nghe tiếng của Giu-đa, \q và đem nó về cùng dân nó; \q tay nó tranh đấu cho nó, \q và nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là sự giúp đỡ [chống lại] kẻ thù nó.
vi.B: Về Giu-đa, ông nói: \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin nghe tiếng của Giu-đa, \q và đem nó về với dân mình. \q Nó tự tay chiến đấu cho chính nghĩa của mình; \q xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp nó chống lại kẻ thù.
vi.R: Đây là điều ông nói về Giu-đa: \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin lắng nghe khi người Giu-đa kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Xin đem họ về với dân mình. \q Họ dùng hết sức để tự chiến đấu cho mình. \q Xin giúp họ chống lại kẻ thù.

ko.L: 그리고 유다에 대하여는 이러하다. 그가 말하였다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 유다의 목소리를 들으시고, \q 그를 그의 백성에게로 데려오십시오. \q 그의 손이 그를 위하여 싸우니, \q 주님께서 그의 적들을 막는 도움이 되어 주십시오.
ko.B: 유다에 대하여 그가 말하였다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 유다의 목소리를 들으시고 \q 그를 그의 백성에게로 데려오십시오. \q 그가 자기 손으로 자기를 위해 싸우니, \q 그의 원수들을 막아 그를 도와주십시오.
ko.R: 유다에 대해서는 이렇게 말했다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 유다 사람들이 주님께 부르짖을 때 들어 주십시오. \q 그들을 그들의 백성에게로 데려와 주십시오. \q 그들은 온 힘을 다해 스스로 싸웁니다. \q 원수들을 막아 그들을 도와주십시오.

pt.L: E isto [é] para Judá; e ele disse: \q Ouve, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, a voz de Judá, \q e traze-o ao seu povo; \q as suas mãos lutam por ele, \q e um socorro contra os seus adversários {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} serás.
pt.B: Sobre Judá ele disse isto: \q Ouve, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, a voz de Judá, \q e traze-o de volta ao seu povo. \q Ele luta pela sua causa com as próprias mãos; \q ajuda-o contra os seus inimigos.
pt.R: Sobre Judá ele disse isto: \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, escuta os homens de Judá quando clamarem a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Traze-os de volta ao seu povo. \q Eles lutam por si mesmos com todas as forças. \q Ajuda-os contra os seus inimigos.

am.L: ለይሁዳም ይህ [ነው]፤ እንዲህም አለ፦ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ የይሁዳን ድምፅ ስማ፤ \q ወደ ሕዝቡም አምጣው፤ \q እጆቹ ስለ እርሱ ይታገላሉ፤ \q ከጠላቶቹም ላይ ረዳት ሁንለት።
am.B: ስለ ይሁዳ ይህን አለ፦ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ የይሁዳን ድምፅ ስማ፤ \q ወደ ሕዝቡም መልሰው። \q በገዛ እጆቹ ስለ ጉዳዩ ይዋጋል፤ \q በጠላቶቹ ላይ ረዳቱ ሁን።
am.R: ስለ ይሁዳ የተናገረው ይህ ነው፦ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ የይሁዳ ሰዎች ወደ አንተ ሲጮኹ ስማቸው። \q ወደ ገዛ ሕዝባቸው መልሳቸው። \q በሙሉ ኃይላቸው ለራሳቸው ይዋጋሉ። \q በጠላቶቻቸው ላይ እርዳቸው።

decisions.choice: hear the voice of Judah and bring him to his people: answer Judah's prayer in battle and bring him home
alternatives: bring him to his people: unite Judah with the rest of Israel
decisions.reason: Judah calls to God for help, most likely in war, and the prayer is that he come back safely to his people. Some see a prayer that Judah, when it stood apart from the other tribes, be joined to them again.

decisions.choice: his hands contend for him: Judah fights for his own cause
alternatives: let his hands be strong for him
decisions.reason: The words can be read as a statement, "with his hands he contends for it", or as a wish, "may his hands be enough for him". A change of one letter would give "your hands", God's hands, fighting for Judah. The line asks God to help where Judah's own strength is not enough.

decisions.choice: Simeon is not named
decisions.reason: Simeon has no saying of its own in the Blessing. Its land later lay inside Judah's (Joshua 19:1, 9), and Jacob had said Simeon would be scattered (Genesis 49:5-7).

decisions.choice: they; them; their
decisions.reason: Readable speaks of the tribe as "they", since the name stands for a whole people.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} (no article)
decisions.reason: Moses calls on the LORD by name, and a name in the vocative takes no article, so the span is "SENHOR|Javé", as in Exodus 32:11 and Genesis 49:18; the same in verse 11.

source.text: וּלְלֵוִ֣י אָמַ֔ר תֻּמֶּ֥יךָ וְאוּרֶ֖יךָ לְאִ֣ישׁ חֲסִידֶ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִסִּיתוֹ֙ בְּמַסָּ֔ה תְּרִיבֵ֖הוּ עַל־מֵ֥י מְרִיבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And for Levi he said: your Thummim and your Urim [are] for [the] man of your faithful one, whom you tested at Massah; you contended [with] him at [the] waters of Meribah.

en.L: And of Levi he said: \q Your Thummim and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} Urim [belong] to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful man, \q whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} tested at Massah, \q with whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} contended at the waters of Meribah,
en.B: Of Levi he said: \q Your Thummim and Urim belong to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful one, \q the man {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} tested at Massah, \q with whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} strove at the waters of Meribah,
en.R: This is what he said about Levi: \q Your Thummim and Urim, used to learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} will, \q belong to the men who are faithful to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q You tested them at Massah and argued with them at the waters of Meribah.

es.L: Y de Leví dijo: \q Tu tumim y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} urim [pertenecen] a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} hombre fiel, \q a quien probaste en Masá, \q con quien contendiste junto a las aguas de Meribá,
es.B: De Leví dijo: \q Tu tumim y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} urim pertenecen a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fiel, \q al hombre que pusiste a prueba en Masá, \q con quien luchaste junto a las aguas de Meribá,
es.R: Esto es lo que dijo acerca de Leví: \q Tu tumim y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} urim, que sirven para conocer {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voluntad, \q pertenecen a los hombres que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} son fieles. \q Los pusiste a prueba en Masá y discutiste con ellos junto a las aguas de Meribá.

fr.L: Et de Lévi il dit : \q Tes toummim et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ourim [appartiennent] à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} homme fidèle, \q que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as éprouvé à Massa, \q avec qui {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as contesté aux eaux de Meriba,
fr.B: De Lévi il dit : \q Tes toummim et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ourim appartiennent à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} fidèle, \q l’homme que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as mis à l’épreuve à Massa, \q avec qui {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as lutté aux eaux de Meriba,
fr.R: Voici ce qu’il a dit au sujet de Lévi : \q Tes toummim et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ourim, qui servent à connaître {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} volonté, \q appartiennent aux hommes qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} sont fidèles. \q Tu les as mis à l’épreuve à Massa et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as discuté avec eux aux eaux de Meriba.

sw.L: Na kuhusu Lawi akasema: \q Thumimu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na Urimu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} [ni] za mtu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mwaminifu, \q uliyemjaribu huko Masa, \q uliyeshindana naye kwenye maji ya Meriba,
sw.B: Kuhusu Lawi alisema: \q Thumimu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na Urimu ni mali ya mwaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q mtu uliyemjaribu huko Masa, \q uliyeshindana naye kwenye maji ya Meriba,
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo alivyosema kuhusu Lawi: \q Thumimu na Urimu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, zinazotumika kujua mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, \q ni za watu walio waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}. \q Uliwajaribu huko Masa na kubishana nao kwenye maji ya Meriba.

vi.L: Và về Lê-vi, ông nói: \q Thu-mim của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và U-rim của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [thuộc về] người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q người mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thử tại Ma-sa, \q người mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đối chất tại nước Mê-ri-ba,
vi.B: Về Lê-vi, ông nói: \q Thu-mim và U-rim của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thuộc về người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q là người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thử thách tại Ma-sa \q và đã đối chất tại nước Mê-ri-ba,
vi.R: Đây là điều ông nói về Lê-vi: \q Thu-mim và U-rim của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, dùng để biết ý {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q thuộc về những người trung tín với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài đã thử thách họ tại Ma-sa và tranh luận với họ tại dòng nước Mê-ri-ba.

ko.L: 그리고 레위에 대하여 그가 말하였다. \q 주님의 둠밈과 주님의 우림은 주님의 신실한 사람에게 [속합니다]. \q 주님께서 맛사에서 그를 시험하셨고, \q 므리바 물가에서 그와 다투셨습니다.
ko.B: 레위에 대하여 그가 말하였다. \q 주님의 둠밈과 우림은 주님께 신실한 사람의 것입니다. \q 주님께서 그를 맛사에서 시험하시고 \q 므리바 물가에서 그와 다투셨습니다.
ko.R: 레위에 대해서는 이렇게 말했다. \q 주님의 뜻을 알아보는 둠밈과 우림은 \q 주님께 충성하는 사람들의 것입니다. \q 주님께서는 맛사에서 그들을 시험하시고 므리바 물가에서 그들과 다투셨습니다.

pt.L: E sobre Levi ele disse: \q O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} Tumim e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} Urim [pertencem] ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} homem fiel, \q a quem {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} provaste em Massá, \q com quem {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} contendeste junto às águas de Meribá,
pt.B: Sobre Levi ele disse: \q O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} Tumim e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} Urim pertencem àquele que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} é fiel, \q o homem que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} puseste à prova em Massá, \q com quem {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} disputaste junto às águas de Meribá,
pt.R: Sobre Levi ele disse isto: \q O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} Tumim e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} Urim, usados para conhecer a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} vontade, \q pertencem aos homens que são fiéis a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Tu os puseste à prova em Massá e discutiste com eles junto às águas de Meribá.

am.L: ስለ ሌዊም እንዲህ አለ፦ \q ቱሚምህና ኡሪምህ ለታማኙ ሰውህ [ናቸው]፤ \q በማሳህ የፈተንከው፣ \q በመሪባ ውኃ አጠገብ የተከራከርከው፤
am.B: ስለ ሌዊ እንዲህ አለ፦ \q ቱሚምህና ኡሪምህ ለታማኙ ሰውህ ናቸው፤ \q በማሳህ ለፈተንከው ሰው፣ \q በመሪባ ውኃ አጠገብ ለታገልከው፤
am.R: ስለ ሌዊ የተናገረው ይህ ነው፦ \q ፈቃድህን ለማወቅ የሚያገለግሉት ቱሚምህና ኡሪምህ \q ለአንተ ታማኝ ለሆኑት ሰዎች ይሁኑ። \q በማሳህ ፈተንካቸው፤ በመሪባ ውኃ አጠገብም ተከራከርካቸው።

decisions.choice: Thummim and Urim: the lots the high priest used to ask God's will
decisions.reason: They were kept in the breastpiece of the high priest (Exodus 28:30; Leviticus 8:8) and used to receive God's answer to a question (Numbers 27:21; 1 Samuel 14:41). Only here is Thummim named first. They belong to Levi because the priests came from that tribe.

decisions.choice: the Hebrew begins "your Thummim"
decisions.reason: The Greek translation, and a Hebrew text of these verses found at Qumran, begin "Give to Levi your Thummim", making the line a prayer. The source text has only "of Levi he said". Reviewers should check the evidence.

decisions.choice: Massah and Meribah: where Israel tested God, and Levi was tested
decisions.reason: At Massah and Meribah the people tested the LORD and quarreled with Moses (Exodus 17:1-7; Numbers 20:1-13; 6:16). Here it is God who tests Levi there; Moses and Aaron, both of Levi, stood at the center of those events. The tribe was proved in the hard times of the wilderness.

decisions.choice: your faithful man: Levi, the one loyal to God
decisions.reason: The word means one who is loyal and devoted, from the word for steadfast love. It speaks of the tribe as one man, as the next verse does.

decisions.choice: used to learn your will; them
alternatives: your Thummim and your Urim; him
decisions.reason: Readable says briefly what Thummim and Urim were for, and speaks of the tribe's men in the plural.

decisions.choice: a deity_pronoun span on "yako" in "Thumimu yako"
alternatives: no span on the first "your", as in English
decisions.reason: English writes "Your Thummim" at the start of the line without a span; Swahili puts the possessive after the noun, so it is not sentence-initial and takes the span like the other pronouns for God.

decisions.choice: "đối chất" for contend (rib)
decisions.reason: "đối chất" (to confront face to face) keeps the sense of a dispute brought into the open, which is what the name Meribah recalls, without suggesting a quarrel between equals.

decisions.choice: "둠밈과 우림" in the Hebrew order
decisions.reason: Elsewhere the pair is "우림과 둠밈" (term sheet); here the Hebrew names Thummim first, and Korean keeps that order as the English does.

decisions.choice: Verse 8 ends as a full sentence; verse 9 starts a new one with "그는" (L, B), "그들은" (R)
decisions.reason: The English continues verse 8 into verse 9 with "who said ...". A Korean relative clause comes before its noun, so it cannot reach back across the verse marker; each verse keeps its own content as a sentence.

decisions.choice: o Tumim e o Urim
decisions.reason: The lots kept in the high priest's breastpiece (m1) keep the Portuguese names of Exodus 28:30, "o Urim e o Tumim", here in the Hebrew's order, with Thummim first, as the English does. Readable says in a few words what they were for.

decisions.choice: "ቱሚምህና ኡሪምህ", in the Hebrew order
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the Thummim first here, unlike elsewhere; Amharic keeps that order at every level.

source.text: הָאֹמֵ֞ר לְאָבִ֤יו וּלְאִמּוֹ֙ לֹ֣א רְאִיתִ֔יו וְאֶת־אֶחָיו֙ לֹ֣א הִכִּ֔יר וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו לֹ֣א יָדָ֑ע כִּ֤י שָֽׁמְרוּ֙ אִמְרָתֶ֔ךָ וּבְרִֽיתְךָ֖ יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: The [one] saying of his father and of his mother, I have not seen him; and his brothers he did not recognize, and his sons he did not know; for they kept your word, and your covenant they guarded.

en.L: who said of his father and of his mother, 'I have not seen him'; \q and his brothers he did not acknowledge, \q and his children he did not know; \q for they kept {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word, \q and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} covenant they guarded.
en.B: who said of his father and mother, 'I have no regard for them.' \q He would not acknowledge his brothers \q or claim his own children, \q for they kept {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word \q and guarded {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} covenant.
en.R: They said about their father and mother, 'They mean nothing to us.' \q They turned away from their brothers \q and did not favor their own children. \q They obeyed {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word \q and kept {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} covenant.

es.L: el que dijo de su padre y de su madre: “No lo he visto”; \q y a sus hermanos no reconoció, \q y a sus hijos no conoció; \q porque guardaron {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra, \q y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pacto custodiaron.
es.B: el que dijo de su padre y de su madre: “No me importan”. \q No quiso reconocer a sus hermanos \q ni tomar partido por sus propios hijos, \q porque guardaron {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra \q y custodiaron {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pacto.
es.R: Dijeron de su padre y de su madre: “No significan nada para nosotros”. \q Se apartaron de sus hermanos \q y no favorecieron a sus propios hijos. \q Obedecieron {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra \q y cumplieron {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pacto.

fr.L: lui qui a dit de son père et de sa mère : “Je ne l’ai pas vu” ; \q et ses frères, il ne les a pas reconnus, \q et ses enfants, il ne les a pas connus ; \q car ils ont gardé {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} alliance, ils l’ont observée.
fr.B: lui qui a dit de son père et de sa mère : “Je ne fais aucun cas d’eux.” \q Il n’a pas voulu reconnaître ses frères \q ni s’attacher à ses propres enfants, \q car ils ont gardé {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole \q et veillé sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} alliance.
fr.R: Ils ont dit de leur père et de leur mère : “Ils ne comptent pas pour nous.” \q Ils se sont détournés de leurs frères \q et n’ont pas favorisé leurs propres enfants. \q Ils ont obéi à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole \q et respecté {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} alliance.

sw.L: aliyesema juu ya baba yake na mama yake, 'Sijamwona'; \q wala ndugu zake hakuwatambua, \q wala watoto wake hakuwajua; \q kwa maana walilishika neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, \q na agano {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} walililinda.
sw.B: aliyesema kuhusu baba yake na mama yake, 'Siwajali.' \q Hakukubali kuwatambua ndugu zake \q wala kuwatetea watoto wake mwenyewe, \q kwa sababu walilishika neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} \q na kulilinda agano {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.R: Walisema kuhusu baba yao na mama yao, 'Hawana maana kwetu.' \q Waliwaacha ndugu zao \q wala hawakuwapendelea watoto wao wenyewe. \q Walilitii neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} \q na kulishika agano {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.

vi.L: người đã nói về cha mình và mẹ mình: 'Tôi không thấy người'; \q và anh em mình, nó không nhận biết, \q và con cái mình, nó không biết; \q vì họ đã giữ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và gìn giữ giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: người đã nói về cha mẹ mình: 'Tôi chẳng đoái hoài đến họ.' \q Nó không nhìn nhận anh em mình \q cũng không nhận con cái mình, \q vì họ đã vâng giữ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và gìn giữ giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Họ nói về cha mẹ mình: 'Cha mẹ chẳng là gì đối với chúng tôi.' \q Họ quay lưng với anh em mình \q và không thiên vị con cái mình. \q Họ vâng theo lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và giữ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그는 자기 아버지와 자기 어머니에 대하여 '내가 그를 보지 못하였다' 하고 말하였습니다. \q 그리고 자기 형제들을 알아보지 않았고, \q 자기 자식들을 알지 않았습니다. \q 이는 그들이 주님의 말씀을 지키고 \q 주님의 언약을 굳게 지켰기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그는 자기 부모를 두고 '나는 그들을 상관하지 않는다' 하고 말하였습니다. \q 자기 형제들도 모른 체하고 \q 자기 자식들도 자기 자식으로 여기지 않았습니다. \q 그들은 주님의 말씀을 지키고 \q 주님의 언약을 굳게 지켰습니다.
ko.R: 그들은 자기 아버지와 어머니에 대해 '그분들은 우리와 상관없다' 하고 말했습니다. \q 자기 형제들에게서도 돌아섰고 \q 자기 자식들의 편도 들지 않았습니다. \q 그들은 주님의 말씀에 순종하고 \q 주님의 언약을 지켰습니다.

pt.L: que disse do seu pai e da sua mãe: 'Eu não o vi'; \q e os seus irmãos ele não reconheceu, \q e os seus filhos ele não conheceu; \q pois guardaram a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra \q e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} aliança eles preservaram.
pt.B: que disse do pai e da mãe: 'Não faço caso deles.' \q Ele não reconheceu os seus irmãos \q nem quis saber dos próprios filhos, \q pois eles guardaram a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra \q e preservaram a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} aliança.
pt.R: Eles disseram sobre o pai e a mãe: 'Eles não significam nada para nós.' \q Deram as costas aos seus irmãos \q e não favoreceram os próprios filhos. \q Obedeceram à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra \q e guardaram a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} aliança.

am.L: ስለ አባቱና ስለ እናቱ፦ “አላየሁትም” ያለ፣ \q ወንድሞቹንም ያልተቀበለ፣ \q ልጆቹንም ያላወቀ [ነው]፤ \q ቃልህን ጠብቀዋልና፤ \q ቃል ኪዳንህንም ተንከባክበዋል።
am.B: እርሱ ስለ አባቱና እናቱ፦ “ለእነርሱ ግድ የለኝም” ያለ ነው። \q ወንድሞቹን አላወቀም፤ \q የገዛ ልጆቹንም አልለየም፤ \q ቃልህን ጠብቀዋልና፤ \q ቃል ኪዳንህንም ተንከባክበዋል።
am.R: ስለ አባታቸውና ስለ እናታቸው፦ “ለእኛ ምንም አይደሉም” አሉ። \q ከወንድሞቻቸው ዘወር አሉ፤ \q ለገዛ ልጆቻቸውም አላደሉም። \q ቃልህን ታዘዙ፤ \q ቃል ኪዳንህንም ጠበቁ።

decisions.choice: father, mother, brothers, children: the Levites' loyalty at the golden calf
decisions.reason: When Israel made the golden calf, the Levites rallied to Moses and struck down the guilty, sparing no brother, friend or neighbor (Exodus 32:26-29). Phinehas showed the same zeal (Numbers 25:7-13). Loyalty to the LORD came before loyalty to family (13:7-12).

decisions.choice: I have not seen him; did not acknowledge; did not know: did not take the side of family
decisions.reason: Not seeing, not recognizing and not knowing are ways of saying he refused to favor his own kin when they stood against God. The words do not mean he never knew them.

decisions.choice: he ... they: the tribe spoken of as one man and as many
decisions.reason: The verse moves from "he" to "they", the tribe as a single figure and as its members, as Hebrew often does.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks
decisions.reason: Words quoted inside the Blessing take single quotation marks, since the whole poem is inside the double quotation mark that opened at verse 2.

decisions.choice: They mean nothing to us; they
alternatives: I have not seen him; he
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the saying and keeps the tribe in the plural, as in verse 8.

source.text: יוֹר֤וּ מִשְׁפָּטֶ֨יךָ֙ לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב וְתוֹרָתְךָ֖ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יָשִׂ֤ימוּ קְטוֹרָה֙ בְּאַפֶּ֔ךָ וְכָלִ֖יל עַֽל־מִזְבְּחֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: They will teach your judgments to Jacob, and your law to Israel; they will put incense in your nose, and whole offering on your altar.

en.L: They teach {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} judgments to Jacob \q and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} law to Israel; \q they put incense in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} nostrils \q and whole offerings on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} altar.
en.B: They teach {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rulings to Jacob \q and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} law to Israel; \q they set incense before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} \q and whole burnt offerings on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} altar.
en.R: They teach {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rules to Jacob's people \q and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching to Israel. \q They burn incense for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to smell \q and offer whole burnt offerings on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} altar.

es.L: Enseñan {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} juicios a Jacob \q y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ley a Israel; \q ponen incienso en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nariz \q y holocausto entero sobre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} altar.
es.B: Enseñan {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} normas a Jacob \q y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ley a Israel; \q presentan el incienso delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} \q y holocaustos completos sobre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} altar.
es.R: Enseñan {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} normas al pueblo de Jacob \q y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enseñanza a Israel. \q Queman incienso para que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} lo huelas \q y ofrecen holocaustos sobre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} altar.

fr.L: Ils enseignent {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} jugements à Jacob \q et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi à Israël ; \q ils mettent l’encens dans {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} narines \q et l’holocauste complet sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} autel.
fr.B: Ils enseignent {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} règles à Jacob \q et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi à Israël ; \q ils présentent l’encens devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} \q et les holocaustes complets sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} autel.
fr.R: Ils enseignent {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} règles au peuple de Jacob \q et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement à Israël. \q Ils brûlent de l’encens pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} en sentes l’odeur \q et ils offrent des holocaustes sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} autel.

sw.L: Wanamfundisha Yakobo hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} \q na Israeli sheria {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; \q wanaweka uvumba puani {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}} \q na sadaka nzima juu ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Wanamfundisha Yakobo maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} \q na Israeli sheria {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; \q wanafukiza uvumba mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} \q na sadaka nzima za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Wanawafundisha watu wa Yakobo maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} \q na Israeli mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. \q Wanafukiza uvumba ili {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uinuse harufu yake \q na kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

vi.L: Họ dạy các mạng lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho Gia-cốp \q và luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho Y-sơ-ra-ên; \q họ đặt hương trong mũi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và của lễ thiêu trọn trên bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Họ dạy các mạng lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho Gia-cốp \q và luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho Y-sơ-ra-ên; \q họ dâng hương trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và dâng của lễ thiêu trọn vẹn trên bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Họ dạy cho dân Gia-cốp các quy định của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và dạy Y-sơ-ra-ên lời dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Họ đốt hương để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngửi mùi thơm \q và dâng của lễ thiêu trọn vẹn trên bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그들이 주님의 법도를 야곱에게 가르치고 \q 주님의 율법을 이스라엘에게 [가르칩니다]. \q 그들이 주님의 코에 향을 두고 \q 주님의 제단 위에 온전한 제물을 [드립니다].
ko.B: 그들은 주님의 법도를 야곱에게 가르치고 \q 주님의 율법을 이스라엘에게 가르칩니다. \q 그들은 주님 앞에 향을 피우고 \q 주님의 제단 위에 온전한 번제를 드립니다.
ko.R: 그들은 주님의 법을 야곱 자손에게 가르치고 \q 주님의 가르침을 이스라엘에게 전합니다. \q 그들은 주님께서 맡으시도록 향을 피우고 \q 주님의 제단 위에 통째로 태우는 번제를 드립니다.

pt.L: Eles ensinam os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} juízos a Jacó \q e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} lei a Israel; \q põem incenso nas {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} narinas \q e a oferta inteira sobre o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} altar.
pt.B: Eles ensinam as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} ordenanças a Jacó \q e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} lei a Israel; \q oferecem incenso diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} \q e holocaustos completos sobre o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} altar.
pt.R: Eles ensinam as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} regras ao povo de Jacó \q e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino a Israel. \q Queimam incenso para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sintas o aroma \q e oferecem holocaustos completos no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} altar.

am.L: ፍርዶችህን ለያዕቆብ፣ \q ሕግህንም ለእስራኤል ያስተምራሉ፤ \q በአፍንጫህ ፊት ዕጣንን፣ \q በመሠዊያህም ላይ ሙሉውን መሥዋዕት ያኖራሉ።
am.B: ደንቦችህን ለያዕቆብ፣ \q ሕግህንም ለእስራኤል ያስተምራሉ፤ \q በፊትህ ዕጣንን፣ \q በመሠዊያህም ላይ ሙሉ በሙሉ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትን ያቀርባሉ።
am.R: ሕጎችህን ለያዕቆብ ዘሮች፣ \q ትምህርትህንም ለእስራኤል ያስተምራሉ። \q እንድታሸተው ዕጣን ያጥናሉ፤ \q በመሠዊያህም ላይ ሙሉ በሙሉ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያቀርባሉ።

decisions.choice: they teach: the priests' task of teaching God's law
decisions.reason: The priests taught Israel the LORD's rulings and decided hard cases by them (17:9-11; 24:8; Leviticus 10:11; Malachi 2:6-7). Teaching comes first here, before the offerings.

decisions.choice: in your nostrils: before you, for you to smell
decisions.reason: The smoke of incense rising to God is spoken of as something he smells and delights in (Genesis 8:21; Leviticus 1:9).

decisions.choice: whole offering: an offering burned completely on the altar
decisions.reason: The word means "complete, whole". It names a burnt offering of which nothing was kept back (Leviticus 6:15-16; 1 Samuel 7:9).

decisions.choice: rulings; rules; teaching
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the settled words for mishpatim and torah: Literal "judgments" and "law", Balanced "rulings" and "law", Readable "rules" and "teaching".

decisions.choice: before you
decisions.reason: Balanced says where the incense is offered rather than keep the picture of God smelling it; Readable keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: "của lễ thiêu trọn" (L) / "của lễ thiêu trọn vẹn" (B, R) for the whole offering (kalil)
decisions.reason: As the Vietnamese of Psalm 51:21 renders the same word, kept apart from the ordinary "của lễ thiêu" (burnt offering).

decisions.choice: os teus juízos, a tua lei (L); as tuas ordenanças, a tua lei (B); as tuas regras, o teu ensino (R); a oferta inteira (L), holocaustos completos (B, R)
decisions.reason: Portuguese keeps the book's words for mishpatim and torah at each level, as the English does: "ordenanças" and "lei" at Balanced, "regras" and "ensino" at Readable; Literal says "juízos" for the English "judgments". The offering burned whole (m3) is "a oferta inteira" at Literal, which keeps it apart from the usual word for the burnt offering, and "holocaustos completos" at Balanced and Readable, as the English says "whole burnt offerings".

source.text: בָּרֵ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ חֵיל֔וֹ וּפֹ֥עַל יָדָ֖יו תִּרְצֶ֑ה מְחַ֨ץ מָתְנַ֧יִם קָמָ֛יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֖יו מִן־יְקוּמֽוּן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Bless, Yahweh, his strength, and [the] work of his hands may you accept; smite [the] loins of those rising against him and those hating him from their rising.

en.L: Bless, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, his strength, \q and the work of his hands may {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} accept; \q strike the loins of those who rise against him and of those who hate him, so that they do not rise.
en.B: Bless his strength, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and be pleased with the work of his hands. \q Crush the loins of all who rise against him and of those who hate him, so that they never rise again.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, bless the strength of Levi's tribe, \q and accept the work they do for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Crush their enemies and those who hate them so that they never get up again.

es.L: Bendice, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, su fuerza, \q y la obra de sus manos acepta; \q hiere los lomos de los que se levantan contra él y de los que lo aborrecen, para que no se levanten.
es.B: Bendice su fuerza, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y agrádate de la obra de sus manos. \q Quiebra los lomos de todos los que se alzan contra él y de los que lo odian, para que nunca más se levanten.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, bendice la fuerza de la tribu de Leví \q y acepta el trabajo que hacen para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Aplasta a sus enemigos y a los que los odian, para que nunca vuelvan a levantarse.

fr.L: Bénis, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sa force, \q et l’œuvre de ses mains, puisses-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’agréer ; \q frappe les reins de ceux qui se dressent contre lui et de ceux qui le haïssent, pour qu’ils ne se relèvent pas.
fr.B: Bénis sa force, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et accueille avec faveur l’œuvre de ses mains. \q Brise les reins de tous ceux qui se dressent contre lui et de ceux qui le haïssent, pour qu’ils ne se relèvent jamais.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, bénis la force de la tribu de Lévi \q et accepte le travail qu’ils font pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Écrase leurs ennemis et ceux qui les haïssent, pour qu’ils ne se relèvent plus jamais.

sw.L: Bariki, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nguvu zake, \q na kazi ya mikono yake uikubali; \q piga viuno vya wale wanaoinuka dhidi yake na vya wale wanaomchukia, wasiinuke.
sw.B: Ubariki nguvu zake, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q upendezwe na kazi ya mikono yake. \q Uvunje viuno vya wote wanaoinuka dhidi yake na vya wale wanaomchukia, wasiinuke tena kamwe.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ubariki nguvu za kabila la Lawi, \q uikubali kazi wanayokufanyia. \q Uwaponde adui zao na wale wanaowachukia, ili wasiinuke tena kamwe.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin ban phước cho sức mạnh của nó, \q và việc tay nó làm, xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chấp nhận; \q xin đập nát hông những kẻ nổi lên chống nó và những kẻ ghét nó, để chúng không trỗi dậy [nữa].
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin ban phước cho sức lực của nó \q và vui nhận công việc tay nó làm. \q Xin đập tan hông những kẻ nổi lên chống nó và những kẻ ghét nó, để chúng không bao giờ trỗi dậy được nữa.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin ban phước cho sức mạnh của chi tộc Lê-vi \q và chấp nhận công việc họ làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Xin đánh tan kẻ thù của họ và những kẻ ghét họ, để chúng không bao giờ đứng dậy được nữa.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 그의 힘에 복을 주시고, \q 그의 손이 하는 일을 기쁘게 받아 주십시오. \q 그를 대적하여 일어나는 자들과 그를 미워하는 자들의 허리를 치셔서 그들이 일어나지 못하게 하십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 그의 힘에 복을 주시고 \q 그가 손으로 하는 일을 기뻐해 주십시오. \q 그를 치러 일어나는 자들과 그를 미워하는 자들의 허리를 꺾으셔서 그들이 다시는 일어나지 못하게 하십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 레위 지파의 힘에 복을 주시고 \q 그들이 주님을 위해 하는 일을 기쁘게 받아 주십시오. \q 그들의 원수들과 그들을 미워하는 자들을 쳐부수셔서 다시는 일어나지 못하게 하십시오.

pt.L: Abençoa, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, a sua força, \q e que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aceites a obra das suas mãos; \q fere os lombos dos que se levantam contra ele e dos que o odeiam, para que não se levantem.
pt.B: Abençoa a sua força, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q e agrada-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} da obra das suas mãos. \q Esmaga os lombos de todos os que se levantam contra ele e dos que o odeiam, para que nunca mais se levantem.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, abençoa a força da tribo de Levi \q e aceita o trabalho que eles fazem para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Esmaga os inimigos deles e os que os odeiam, para que nunca mais se levantem.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ብርታቱን ባርክ፤ \q የእጆቹንም ሥራ ተቀበል፤ \q በእርሱ ላይ የሚነሡትንና የሚጠሉትን ወገብ ምታ፤ እንዳይነሡም።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ብርታቱን ባርክ፤ \q በእጆቹም ሥራ ደስ ይበልህ። \q በእርሱ ላይ የሚነሡትንና የሚጠሉትን ሁሉ ወገብ ቀጥቅጥ፤ ዳግመኛም እንዳይነሡ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ የሌዊን ነገድ ብርታት ባርክ፤ \q ለአንተ የሚሠሩትንም ሥራ ተቀበል። \q ዳግመኛ እንዳይነሡ ጠላቶቻቸውንና የሚጠሏቸውን ቀጥቅጥ።

decisions.choice: his strength: his ability and power
decisions.reason: The word can mean strength, ability or wealth. The Levites had no land of their own (10:9; 18:1-2), so the prayer is most likely for their strength in God's service.

decisions.choice: strike the loins: break their strength
decisions.reason: The loins are the hips and lower back, the seat of a man's strength (Psalm 69:24; Nahum 2:2). A blow there leaves an enemy unable to stand.

decisions.choice: those who rise against him: those who challenge Levi's priesthood
decisions.reason: The rebellion of Korah, Dathan and Abiram was a challenge to the tribe chosen to serve (Numbers 16-17). The prayer asks God to defend those he has chosen.

decisions.choice: the work they do for you
decisions.reason: Readable says that the work is the priests' service to God.

source.text: לְבִנְיָמִ֣ן אָמַ֔ר יְדִ֣יד יְהֹוָ֔ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶ֖טַח עָלָ֑יו חֹפֵ֤ף עָלָיו֙ כָּל־הַיּ֔וֹם וּבֵ֥ין כְּתֵיפָ֖יו שָׁכֵֽן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For Benjamin he said: [the] beloved of Yahweh will dwell in security upon him; covering over him all the day, and between his shoulders he dwells.

en.L: Of Benjamin he said: \q [The] beloved of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} dwells in safety beside {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shields him all the day, \q and between {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} shoulders he dwells.
en.B: Of Benjamin he said: \q The one {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} loves lives in safety beside {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shelters him all day long, \q and Benjamin rests between {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} shoulders.
en.R: This is what he said about Benjamin: \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} loves Benjamin, who lives safely beside {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q He protects Benjamin all day long, \q and Benjamin rests between {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} shoulders, carried by {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: De Benjamín dijo: \q [El] amado {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} habita seguro junto a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo protege todo el día, \q y entre {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hombros habita.
es.B: De Benjamín dijo: \q Aquel a quien {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ama vive seguro junto a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo resguarda todo el día, \q y Benjamín descansa entre {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hombros.
es.R: Esto es lo que dijo acerca de Benjamín: \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ama a Benjamín, que vive seguro junto a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q Lo protege todo el día, \q y Benjamín descansa entre {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hombros, llevado por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: De Benjamin il dit : \q [Le] bien-aimé {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} demeure en sécurité auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le protège tout le jour, \q et entre {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} épaules il demeure.
fr.B: De Benjamin il dit : \q Celui que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime habite en sécurité auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’abrite tout le jour, \q et Benjamin repose entre {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} épaules.
fr.R: Voici ce qu’il a dit au sujet de Benjamin : \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime Benjamin, qui vit en sécurité auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Il protège Benjamin toute la journée, \q et Benjamin repose entre {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} épaules : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le porte.

sw.L: Kuhusu Benyamini akasema: \q Mpendwa wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anakaa salama karibu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}; \q anamfunika mchana kutwa, \q na kati ya mabega {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} anakaa.
sw.B: Kuhusu Benyamini alisema: \q Yule ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anampenda anaishi salama karibu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}; \q anamhifadhi mchana kutwa, \q na Benyamini anapumzika kati ya mabega {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo alivyosema kuhusu Benyamini: \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anampenda Benyamini, anayeishi salama karibu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. \q Anamlinda Benyamini mchana kutwa, \q na Benyamini anapumzika kati ya mabega {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, akibebwa {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.

vi.L: Và về Bên-gia-min, ông nói: \q Người yêu dấu của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở an ninh bên cạnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} che chở nó suốt ngày, \q và nó ở giữa hai vai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Về Bên-gia-min, ông nói: \q Người được {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu dấu sống an ninh bên cạnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} che chở nó suốt ngày, \q và Bên-gia-min nghỉ yên giữa hai vai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đây là điều ông nói về Bên-gia-min: \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu thương Bên-gia-min, là người sống an toàn bên cạnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài bảo vệ Bên-gia-min suốt ngày, \q và Bên-gia-min nghỉ yên giữa hai vai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mang trên vai.

ko.L: 그리고 베냐민에 대하여 그가 말하였다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 사랑을 받는 자가 그분 곁에서 안전하게 산다. \q 그분께서 온종일 그를 감싸 주시고, \q 그가 그분의 어깨 사이에 산다.
ko.B: 베냐민에 대하여 그가 말하였다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사랑하시는 자는 그분 곁에서 안전하게 산다. \q 그분께서 온종일 그를 감싸 보호하시니, \q 베냐민이 그분의 어깨 사이에서 쉰다.
ko.R: 베냐민에 대해서는 이렇게 말했다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 베냐민을 사랑하시니, 베냐민은 그분 곁에서 안전하게 산다. \q 그분께서 온종일 베냐민을 지켜 주시고, \q 베냐민은 그분의 등에 업혀 그 두 어깨 사이에서 쉰다.

pt.L: Sobre Benjamim ele disse: \q [O] amado {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} habita em segurança junto a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o protege o dia todo, \q e entre os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} ombros ele habita.
pt.B: Sobre Benjamim ele disse: \q Aquele que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ama vive em segurança junto a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o abriga o dia inteiro, \q e Benjamim descansa entre os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} ombros.
pt.R: Sobre Benjamim ele disse isto: \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ama Benjamim, que vive em segurança junto a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \q Ele protege Benjamim o dia inteiro, \q e Benjamim descansa entre os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} ombros, carregado por {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

am.L: ስለ ብንያምም እንዲህ አለ፦ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ወዳጅ በአጠገቡ ተማምኖ ይኖራል፤ \q ቀኑን ሁሉ ይጋርደዋል፤ \q በትከሻዎቹም መካከል ያድራል።
am.B: ስለ ብንያም እንዲህ አለ፦ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚወደው በአጠገቡ ተማምኖ ይኖራል፤ \q ቀኑን ሙሉ ይከልለዋል፤ \q ብንያምም በትከሻዎቹ መካከል ያርፋል።
am.R: ስለ ብንያም የተናገረው ይህ ነው፦ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ብንያምን ይወደዋል፤ እርሱም በአጠገቡ በሰላም ይኖራል። \q ቀኑን ሙሉ ብንያምን ይጠብቀዋል፤ \q ብንያምም ተሸክሞት በትከሻዎቹ መካከል ያርፋል።

decisions.choice: the beloved of the LORD: Benjamin, loved by God
decisions.reason: Benjamin was Jacob's youngest son, the one his father loved and would not let go (Genesis 35:18; 44:20). The same word is used for those God loves (Psalm 127:2; Jeremiah 11:15). It may also look ahead to Solomon, named Jedidiah, "beloved of the LORD" (2 Samuel 12:25).

decisions.choice: between his shoulders he dwells: Benjamin rests between God's shoulders, carried as a child is carried
alternatives: the LORD dwells between Benjamin's shoulders, among his hills
decisions.reason: The verse does not name who rests and whose shoulders are meant. The first lines speak of God sheltering Benjamin, so the last most likely pictures God carrying him on his back, as a father carries his son (1:31). It may instead mean that the LORD dwells between Benjamin's "shoulders", the slopes of his hill country, since the word is used for the side of a hill (Joshua 15:8) and the temple in Jerusalem stood on Benjamin's border (Joshua 18:16). Either way, Benjamin lives close to God.

decisions.choice: beside him ... he shields him: the Hebrew has "upon him" twice
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "upon him" at the end of the first line and "over him" in the second. Some think the first was copied by mistake for a title of God, "the Most High", which has similar letters. The Greek translation reads "God shades him". The source text is kept, and "upon him" is taken to mean close beside the LORD. Reviewers should check the evidence.

decisions.choice: Benjamin rests
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Benjamin as the one who rests, following the reading in m2.

decisions.choice: carried by him
decisions.reason: Readable says what resting between his shoulders means on the reading of m2.

decisions.choice: "그분의 등에 업혀" for "carried by him" at Readable
decisions.reason: A child rests between the shoulders when carried on the back (meaning decision); "업히다" is the Korean word for exactly that.

records.literal_gloss: And for Joseph he said: blessed of Yahweh [is] his land, from [the] choicest of heavens, from dew, and from [the] deep lying beneath,

en.L: And of Joseph he said: \q Blessed by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [be] his land, \q with the choicest gifts of heaven, with the dew, \q and with the deep that lies beneath,
en.B: Of Joseph he said: \q Blessed by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be his land \q with the finest gifts of the sky, with dew, \q and with the deep waters that lie below,
en.R: This is what he said about Joseph: \q May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} bless his land \q with the best gifts from the sky, the dew, \q and with water from deep under the ground.

es.L: Y de José dijo: \q Bendita por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [sea] su tierra, \q con lo más precioso de los cielos, con el rocío, \q y con el abismo tendido en lo profundo,
es.B: De José dijo: \q Bendita por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sea su tierra \q con los mejores dones del cielo, con el rocío, \q y con las aguas profundas que yacen abajo,
es.R: Esto es lo que dijo acerca de José: \q Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} bendiga su tierra \q con los mejores regalos del cielo, el rocío, \q y con el agua de lo profundo de la tierra.

fr.L: Et de Joseph il dit : \q Bénie par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [soit] sa terre, \q des dons les plus précieux du ciel, de la rosée, \q et de l’abîme couché en bas,
fr.B: De Joseph il dit : \q Que sa terre soit bénie par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} \q des plus beaux dons du ciel, de la rosée, \q et des eaux profondes couchées en bas,
fr.R: Voici ce qu’il a dit au sujet de Joseph : \q Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} bénisse son pays \q avec les meilleurs dons du ciel, la rosée, \q et avec l’eau qui vient du fond de la terre.

sw.L: Na kuhusu Yusufu akasema: \q Nchi yake [na] ibarikiwe na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwa vitu bora vya mbinguni, kwa umande, \q na kwa kilindi kinachojilaza chini,
sw.B: Kuhusu Yusufu alisema: \q Nchi yake na ibarikiwe na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q kwa zawadi bora za angani, kwa umande, \q na kwa maji ya kilindi yaliyolala chini,

vi.L: Và về Giô-sép, ông nói: \q Đất của nó [được] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước, \q với những tặng phẩm quý nhất của trời, với sương móc, \q và với vực sâu nằm bên dưới,
